purpose: Artifact blocks that were delivered on an accepted route but must NOT be recovered, because a landed agent report asked for the phrase to be removed from the page. Each entry is a named, justified shrink: it is the only way content may leave a page without the shrink guard failing.
policy: ENUMERATED ONLY. Nothing is withheld by pattern or by inference from a fix's wording - 'rewrite the X block' reads as a removal directive to any verb-based screen, and screening on that basis proposed dropping ten legitimate artifacts including 'Direct answer'. An entry is added by a human, names the exact rendered phrase, and quotes the report that asked for it.
